technical_and_design_decisions: For U1, global DSL options will be implemented by extending the existing DSL configuration model with new attributes for timeout and pollInterval, default values will be applied if not overridden.
For U2, upgrade to Spring Integration 4.2.1 involves updating Maven/Gradle dependencies and verifying compatibility with existing code, followed by regression testing.
For U3, refactor JobLaunchingTasklet by profiling current performance bottlenecks, then optimizing loops, reducing object creation, and improving concurrency handling.
For U4, enhance test coverage by parameterizing existing test suites to cover all DSL and XML generation variants, including edge cases and error conditions.
For U5, support inline SpEL expressions in stream definitions by extending the parser to recognize SpEL syntax within stream strings and integrating with the existing SpEL evaluation context.
For U6, 'job orchestration' documentation will be created as a new section in the existing user guide, including diagrams, code examples, and best practices for batch workflows.
For U7, add 'undeployed' status to YARN SPI by modifying the status enum in the YARN integration module and updating related status mapping logic.
For U8, split the admin artifact by separating Hadoop distribution-specific libraries into separate Maven modules with profiles, ensuring backward compatibility and avoiding dependency conflicts.
assumptions: Developer is experienced with Spring Framework, Spring Integration, YARN, and Hadoop ecosystems.
Existing codebase is well-structured and follows standard Spring project conventions.
All efforts include unit testing and basic integration testing for the specific changes.
No external dependencies require negotiation or new library approvals.
CI/CD pipeline is already in place and will be used for automated builds and tests.
Documentation is written in AsciiDoc and follows the project's existing style.
Effort estimates are for development only, excluding project management, code reviews, or release management activities.
Each user story is implemented independently, with no cascading dependencies that would increase effort.

activities.activity_name: Implement global DSL options for timeout and pollInterval
activities.activity_description: Add global timeout and pollInterval options to the DSL configuration, allowing users to override defaults at the DSL level. Includes parsing, validation, and integration tests.
Update dependency versions, resolve any breaking changes, run full regression test suite, and verify compatibility with existing features.

activities.activity_name: Review and refactor JobLaunchingTasklet for performance
activities.activity_description: Analyze current implementation, identify performance bottlenecks, refactor code to improve throughput and reduce overhead, and add performance-related tests.

activities.activity_name: Enhance test coverage for DSL and XML generation variants
activities.activity_description: Create additional unit and integration tests covering all DSL and XML generation combinations, including edge cases, to increase code coverage and catch regressions.

activities.activity_name: Support inline SpEL expressions at stream definition level
activities.activity_description: Extend the stream definition parser to recognize and evaluate SpEL expressions inline, update the processing pipeline, and add comprehensive tests for various expression scenarios.
Write a new documentation section for job orchestration guidelines, including architecture, configuration examples, and usage patterns for building batch workflows.

activities.activity_name: Add undeployed status for YARN SPI
activities.activity_description: Introduce a new 'undeployed' status constant in the YARN SPI status enum, update all status mapping and handling logic, and add unit tests.

activities.activity_name: Split admin artifact with Hadoop distro-specific libraries
activities.activity_description: Refactor the admin module to separate Hadoop distribution-specific dependencies into separate Maven modules or profiles, update build configuration, and verify that each variant builds and tests correctly.
